findings.claim: the first-non-blank-line attestation rule declined the founding datum: liquid-city blocks open with a # [lc] comment and carry the totem:fork marker second
findings.counterexample: isAttestedTrailer returned false on both live LC hooks at 74abbb3d

findings.claim: tierPinned was dropped on the config-missing and config-load-error returns, so an explicit --strict/--standard was ignored whenever no config resolved; the guarding test passed only because this machine has a home-level config
findings.counterexample: with USERPROFILE at an empty dir, --strict over a standard hook returned exists/standard at 2730adc7

findings.claim: fixtures asserted an attestation shape the field does not produce
findings.counterexample: the ATTESTED_TRAILER fixture began with the marker line; install.cjs emits a label line first

findings.claim: the init half of the delivery claim was false on post-merge and post-checkout and init printed no summary row for the rewrite
findings.counterexample: installPostMergeHook returns on marker presence; init never installs post-checkout

findings.claim: a bare install re-rendered a --strict hook at standard when config pinned no tier (pre-existing on the owned-whole arm; widened by the attested arm)
findings.counterexample: strict hook + attested trailer + no pin gave block-rewritten at standard

findings.claim: the hook-manager helper path rendered outside the tier rule
findings.counterexample: a strict pre-push.sh under .husky regenerated as standard

findings.claim: the changeset contradicted itself on #2138, the migration count and the named-once rule
findings.counterexample: what-changed said the tier fix closes the #2138 hazard while what-did-not-change said unchanged

findings.claim: doctor classified appended-attested by a looser predicate than the install cure, prescribing an inert bare install on a preambled hook
findings.counterexample: a user preamble plus attested trailer was told to run a bare install that declines

findings.claim: the barrel-import directive lacked its ticket ref and named only two of seven dynamic importers
findings.counterexample: AGENTS.md requires a ticket ref on every suppression

findings.claim: remaining minors: legacy-note stutter and plural, CRLF/post-checkout/no-terminator and unavailable-arm tests, ownedTrailerStart reuse, the split-marker and docstring-policy items
findings.counterexample: each reproduced by the legs and folded

verdict: four leg rounds over 3e82124f..b1f389a5: slice leg 1 BLOCKING (the barrel-import rule, resolved by a ticketed directive) folded 74abbb3d; falsification leg 1 BLOCKING (attestation position) 3/7 folded 2730adc7; re-arm 1 BLOCKING (tierPinned on early returns) 2/5 folded c793673f; re-arm 0/5/5 (prose and test strength) folded b1f389a5. Live proof: isAttestedTrailer and isTotemOwnedWithAttestedTrailer true on both liquid-city hooks; identical test counts under a real and an empty home. Ladder terminates.
